examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The same moment in each format: local time, UTC and a relative phrase. Activate one to open the panel with UTC, local, relative and raw values, each with a copy button.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Timestamp from '@aziontech/webkit/timestamp'
  import WebkitProvider from '@aziontech/webkit/webkit-provider'

  const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 14, 12, 10)
  const VALUE = '2026-11-14T12:04:31Z'
</script>

<template>
  <WebkitProvider
    :now="NOW"
    time-zone="America/New_York"
  >
    <dl
      class="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] items-baseline gap-x-(--spacing-md) gap-y-(--spacing-sm) text-body-sm text-(--text-default)"
    >
      <dt class="text-label-sm text-(--text-muted)">Local</dt>
      <dd><Timestamp :value="VALUE" /></dd>
      <dt class="text-label-sm text-(--text-muted)">UTC</dt>
      <dd>
        <Timestamp
          :value="VALUE"
          format="utc"
        />
      </dd>
      <dt class="text-label-sm text-(--text-muted)">Relative</dt>
      <dd>
        <Timestamp
          :value="VALUE"
          format="relative"
        />
      </dd>
    </dl>
  </WebkitProvider>
</template>

examples.name: Time zone
examples.summary: A time zone picker bound to the provider's `time-zone`: changing it changes every local time below at once, and the panel adds your browser's time when the zones differ.

examples.name: Log details
examples.summary: Timestamps in the details panel of one request, beside its status code, where people copy the exact UTC value into a query.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import KeyValueList from '@aziontech/webkit/key-value-list'
  import StatusCode from '@aziontech/webkit/status-code'
  import Timestamp from '@aziontech/webkit/timestamp'
  import WebkitProvider from '@aziontech/webkit/webkit-provider'

  const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 14, 12, 10)
</script>

<template>
  <WebkitProvider
    :now="NOW"
    time-zone="UTC"
  >
    <KeyValueList aria-label="Request details">
      <KeyValueList.Item label="Request">
        <StatusCode
          :code="503"
          method="POST"
        />
      </KeyValueList.Item>
      <KeyValueList.Item label="Path">/api/orders</KeyValueList.Item>
      <KeyValueList.Item label="Started">
        <Timestamp :value="1794657871204000" />
      </KeyValueList.Item>
      <KeyValueList.Item label="Received">
        <Timestamp
          value="2026-11-14T12:04:31.204Z"
          format="relative"
        />
      </KeyValueList.Item>
      <KeyValueList.Item label="Host">app.example.com</KeyValueList.Item>
    </KeyValueList>
  </WebkitProvider>
</template>
